title: Extend the existing Leaflet map with active-ride route layers
acceptanceCriteria: Existing Leaflet map remains the only map instance.
Active ride shows distinct pickup and destination markers.
Route ahead appears as a dashed preview and traveled route remains distinct.
GPS trace points under 8 meters from the prior point are ignored.
Ending or changing the active ride clears only PULSE-053 route layers.
Route lookup failure does not block ride lifecycle or phone navigation.
Inbox QR and current/queued ride hold behavior remain present.
No direct Ride Requests write is added.
No automatic merge, deployment, Engine A/B activation, or production mutation.
Idle/no-active-ride state restores the existing trace style instead of retaining active-trip styling.
Failed route previews back off per ride from 15 seconds up to 5 minutes instead of retrying every 1.2 seconds.

reviewRepair.reason: Copilot review: trace styling applied while idle and failed route preview retried every ~1.2s.
